mutations.name: HH-verify
mutations.what: a pack is shown as it is on disk

patches.new: const value = JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8')); const files = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value.files).map(([name, one]) => [name, Buffer.from(one.base64, 'base64')])); const read = { statement: value.statement, digest: value.statementDigest, files, entries: files['ledger.jsonl'].toString('utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((line) => JSON.parse(line)) };
